text:
Priya R.: quick heads-up — candidate scheduled for system-design + coding on Thu. Panel currently 11:30a PT. Can folks confirm availability? Need one scribe for the debrief, and we should lock rubric weights before the call.
Maya K.: I can join but timezone shift for me (EST) — 2:30p my time, ok. I can be scribe if no one else volunteers.
Samir Patel: available. can we trim live coding to 30m? candidate has limited time. @Priya R. @Maya K. any objections?
Priya R.: proposed weights to start debate: 40/30/30 (design/code/communication). open to suggestions.
Elena V.: i'd prefer 35/35/30 to balance design+coding. worried communication gets undervalued. quick rubric snippet: 
```
weights:
  system_design: 35
  coding: 35
  communication: 30
```
Samir Patel: that seems reasonable. timeline then looks like: 30m coding, 30m design, 15m comm + 15m buffer for debrief/notes.
Jamal: heads up — i can't make 11:30a PT (conflict). can we move to 12:00p PT? if not, i can do async debrief. @Priya R.
Priya R.: 12:00p PT collides with another candidate slot today. two options: (1) swap Jamal with Elena (Elena, can you cover earlier?), (2) keep 11:30 and Jamal does async debrief.
Elena V.: i can swap and join at 11:30a PT. happy to take the deep design part.
Jamal: thanks — swapping now. i'll leave structured async notes in the repo/doc if anything comes up.
Ops Bot: calendar update: panel attendee list changed; invites resent to updated attendees. Recording and transcript enabled. :white_check_mark:
Priya R.: locking rubric to Elena's weights (35/35/30). assigning scribe to Maya. final timeline and doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/hiring/panels/123 — please add quick PR comments or callouts there.
Maya K.: added scribe template and initial placeholder notes. i'll capture timestamps + rubric ratings during interview. :thumbsup:
Priya R.: awesome — thanks everyone. i'll confirm candidate reminder and close loop. ping here for last-minute swaps or rubric disputes.
file_notes: Panel scheduling + rubric clarification thread; short back-and-forth, scribe assignment, calendar bot confirmation.
